predecessor.title: Theorem: common-flag frame obstruction for nonlinear gates
predecessor.body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR825 proves the common-flag rational-frame obstruction for XOR circuits and excludes nonlinear gates. This contribution removes that gate restriction with an information-flow proof.

For arbitrary deterministic pointwise gates over a finite alphabet, the outgoing transcript of a frame-label class must distinguish the independent input symbols whose required outputs leave that class. Weighted label partitions therefore give rank-cost lower certificates. Applying the diagonal characters of a common flag proves `s >= Wm`, including flags over characteristic-zero extension fields, commuting nonsplit frames and noncommuting triangular families. The optimistic recursive moment cannot contract in this class.

Full nonlinear semantics matter: a four-gate Toffoli/CNOT word realizes a CNOT through Boolean idempotence while its CNOT-only subword is identity. The verifier replays complete truth tables and cut transcripts instead of using linear columns.

This is a written structural theorem and exact finite evidence, with no new supplier, exponent or selected-frontier change. Only `research/nonlinear-frame-cut-bound/` is added. The weighted cut statement is proved in the README; the executable instantiates its unit-weight common-flag corollary.

## Task and overlap

- Base main: `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`; contribution: `78a1810e44bf08f845252cfe4c785ccc967c07a2`.
- Changed scope under `bit-new-register-model`, priority revision 3: arbitrary nonlinear scalar gates rather than a finite nonabelian address alphabet. TASK records the exploratory selection and rationale.
- Predecessor: Navinor's PR825, head `421db1ca2eb26056e82797f94b8c4eecd0120620`. SOURCES pins the current-main statement, upstream contract and finite XOR scorer.
- Active claim: [Discussion #1753](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1753), as **jmbarrancoml**.
- Final complete overlap snapshot covered 431 open PRs and 389 Discussion records. The nonlinear Gaussian/Hurwitz copy bounds and fixed-prefix cleanup obstruction have different contracts. An earlier joint-helper investigation matched PR1517 and is not claimed as new.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/nonlinear-frame-cut-bound
```

Registered replay passed on macOS arm64 / CPython 3.12.13. Optimized Python 3.14.6 produced identical JSON. Twelve cases cover 428 full input assignments, 3,830 outside-only simulations, exact rational edge ranks, a sharp equality case, nonsplit characters and eleven failure/boundary controls. Controls include a nonlinear gate that fools zero/one-hot endpoint checks and an omitted outgoing message.

PR825's fourteen examples and thirteen tests, source pins, metadata, selected-record integrity and staged whitespace checks also passed. Finite examples support the written proof; they are not a proof by exhaustive enumeration of arbitrary circuits.

Hosted status: GitHub reports `action_required` for the [registered package run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38538365638). Hosted verification remains outstanding.

## Limits and credit

The theorem retains fixed topology, independent inputs, complete all-role permutation endpoints, one common frame per gate and full edge charging. Arbitrary non-common-flag geometry remains open. There is no claimed full multiplication theorem, new physical/compiler admission, Lean proof, independent human review or hosted-CI pass at submission.

Credit Navinor/PR825, OpenAI's retained finite-shear contract, and the preceding routing and nonlinear cleanup audits. The cut-set counting principle is standard; no literature-priority claim is made for it. Prepared for **Jose Manuel (@jmbarrancoml)** with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, proof, implementation and prose, including read-only mathematical exploration subagents. Apache-2.0; source files and licenses remain intact.

## Open next questions

A five-role mixed nonlinear candidate must have a nonidentity endpoint verified on all 32 inputs, a nonroutable topology, and a rational two-dimensional frame assignment with total rank at most nine. The README gives a non-common-flag frame seed. No such complete witness has been found; a failed bounded search would exclude only its declared domain.
